open_points.subject: Registry store
open_points.text: An instance holds its own store.
open_points.question: What persistence and availability guarantees must the store provide across process restarts, host restarts, crashes and store failures?
options: durable local store that survives restarts
ephemeral store with loss on restart permitted
open_points.default_guess: Use a durable local transactional store and fail requests when it is unavailable.

open_points.subject: Instance configuration
open_points.text: Service tokens, the staff credential, the artifact vocabulary (R0-08) and the frontend origin are the instance's configuration.
open_points.question: What concrete configuration source supplies these values, and which external component is trusted to store and expose it to Registry?
open_points.default_guess: Use mounted configuration and secret files readable only by the Registry process.

open_points.subject: Configuration startup
open_points.text: a change takes effect when the instance restarts
open_points.question: What must Registry observably do when required credentials or the frontend origin are absent, malformed or ambiguous at startup?
options: refuse to start with a diagnostic
start with the affected capability disabled
start with generated or permissive defaults
open_points.default_guess: Refuse to start without exposing secret values.

open_points.subject: Credential provisioning
open_points.text: Each writing service holds a service token that names it; staff hold a staff credential.
open_points.question: Who creates each credential, how is it delivered to its holder, and what trusted system or out-of-band process crosses that secret boundary?
options: the owner generates and distributes credentials out of band
an external secret manager generates and distributes them
open_points.default_guess: The owner generates high-entropy credentials out of band and provisions the same secrets into Registry and the authorized callers.

open_points.subject: Customer contact data in operational outputs
open_points.text: Personal data — the customer's contact data (R0-06); readable by staff only (R0-09).
open_points.question: May customer contact data appear in request logs, response logs, traces, metrics, crash reports or other operational stores, and who may access those outputs?
options: contact data is prohibited from all operational outputs
contact data may appear only in a separately protected staff-only audit store
contact data may appear in ordinary operational outputs whose readers are treated as staff
open_points.default_guess: Prohibit contact data from logs, traces, metrics and crash reports.
